project.name: Reading Notes — synthetic example
project.original_idea: I want to find my reading notes quickly.

brief.audience: One reader, using their own laptop.
brief.outcome: Find and reopen a note by title.

references.observation: Title, text area and search list.

predesign.description: Proposed quiet two-column layout; stacked list and editor on narrow screens; visible keyboard focus.

failures: Empty title: keep input and show error
No results: show clear empty state

acceptance: A matching title appears in results.
No match shows an empty state without deleting notes.
requirements.verification: Planned domain and keyboard journey tests.

technical.architecture: Proposed local-first single-user tool; inspect repository before choosing technology.
technical.data: Note: id, title, body, updated_at; local owner; deletion and export behavior to settle.
technical.security: No credentials or external providers; local device access remains a host concern.
technical.operations: Proposed JSON export/import backup; restoration still to specify.

decisions.source: Synthetic scenario decision; no real human approval.
decisions.evidence: Synthetic fixture only; not an approval in a trusted conversation.

questions.text: What should happen if saving fails?

validation.evidence: This is a planning fixture, not tested software.

next_action: Propose save/recovery behavior and review the direction.
